pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of scaling into consecutive negative trades; pyramiding is authorized only after the initial 0.01 lot achieves a verified +$10.00 floating profit cushion.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero execution allowed during 1-minute ATR spikes exceeding 3.5x the 20-period moving average; mandatory multi-timeframe volume-weighted momentum confirmation required prior to order dispatch.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate automated scaling out or trailing stop locks when open positions reach +$12.00 to guarantee avoidance of profit evaporation.
